Following admission, he was intubated with prone positioning, and treatment was initiated. He was also found to have Staphylococcus hemolyticus bacteremia. The necrosis progressed during the following days, primarily involving the earlobe of the right ear and a large portion of the helix of the left ear.
Erythematous plaque (2 cm) with overlying eschar on the right earlobe. Multiple erythematous edematous erosions with eschar and crust on the helical rim of the left ear.
